reviews.title: Very Fresh, Tasty Seeds
reviews.body: My husband recently received a cancer diagnoses and we have been looking for natural healing options for him. B17 was suggested by several sources and these seeds are very high in B17. We won't know for a while if they are having an affect on his cancer, but the seeds are very tasty, very fresh (bitter at first, but then with a fresh burst of "amaretto" flavor that we now really enjoy). We were advised to start with one seed before each meal, increasing by one more seed before each meal each day (day 1- 1 seed before each meal, day 2- 2 seeds before each meal and so forth) until you reach an amount that causes you to feel queasy. Then back off one seed to what you were taking the day before and continue at that amount before each meal. For me it's 2 seeds, for my husband 7. We'll keep buying this brand because the quality is so good!

If your researching products as I am for a hopefully cancer free future (my note to God’s ears) these need to be a part of your arsenal!! No hesitation!!

reviews.title: **Warning: this may be sensitive/gross for weak stomachs**.
reviews.body: These Apricot seeds are Amazing. I purchased these Feb 2023.They are a *very* bitter aquired taste, but, I promise they're worth it! You can even 'chase it' w/a drink or apple sauce if you want.Last year, I noticed a growth on my right areola. It was tender to touch, extremely hard like a rock, it would become inflamed/red for weeks at a time, to the point that any apparel that barely touched it would be excruciating & it'd even have "goo/blood" come out.I had an ultrasound and the white coats were not able to tell me what it was- go figure.I decided to start taking these (5-6 apricots) twice a day without missing a day. After about 4-5 weeks I started noticing that, I was able to apply pressure on "it" and start squeezing (edibles helped me w/the pain tolerance) and slowly but surely a 'calcium-like' foreign body the size of a pea, squeezed out of the side of my areola! The relief I felt when that thing came out, was instant!!!I still have these Apricots, and I already have the nxt bag in my cart.Recommend 💯!!
